task_description: Build the Node House Bot (REQ-17 / Task 11) in a new apps/house-bot package. Honest mode (11.1) plays a full game through the real @accident/protocol Session (commit, relay, reveal) choosing guesses with @accident/engine. Cheating mode (11.2) lies about one answer, demonstrated and tested as caught via the finalisation lie-detection path. The bot is labelled as a bot in the room (REQ-17.3). All behaviour is tested against the in-memory fakes in @accident/protocol/testing; no live network.
